storylines: GORD: Or it stays at one goal a game and we finish the season with a losing record. One of those two things. CASEY: Up next — Monday, September twenty-first, eight-thirty PM, the Village People hit the road to face the Cannons Hockey. First meeting of the season, so we don't have a book on them yet, but road games have a way of bringing a group together, and after two home losses, maybe a change of scenery is exactly what this team needs. GORD: Or maybe we give up four goals on the road instead of at home. I'm just saying the possibilities are wide open. CASEY: That's Ice & Easy. Thanks for listening — we'll see you Monday.
